## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 2, 2026 - Nov 2, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Theodore B_, Nov 2, 2026, 1/5: "used to be a good app but between the constant bugs, crashes, and now forced AI/subscription nonsense, it's useless."
            2. _Elias Chiddicks_, Oct 25, 2026, 1/5: "Especially for legacy users, this app is unusable. The notebook limitations are the worst, but all of the huge feature limitations and pop-ups for free users make it unusable unless you pay. Speaking of paying, the price of entry is skyhigh for a note taking app. Absolutely no way to rationalise it. I heard the CEO of Bending Spoons talk about how they saved this app but I just can't believe this is how you do it. I've had to migrate away, which makes me sad because the basic UX is still good"
            3. _Michi S_, Oct 21, 2026, 1/5: "I've been using the app since 2015. But the bugs are piling up and the UX is just going downhill. Just snot. New subscriptions again last year (I was still able to keep my old one). The starter plan seems to be exactly the "intermediate solution" that I wanted since bending spoons' subscriptions, but not for €80 but maybe €30. Now you have 1000 notes instead of 150k, 20 notebooks instead of 2k. I don't need AI. It's not even 1% of the old one and it's €80 instead of €100. Great. 😑 Will switch to Obsidian or Upnote."
